    Monte Carlo Estimation of Empirical and Closed-Form Power for OLS PPI / PPI++

    ppi_ols_empirical_power.Rd

    Runs a full Monte Carlo simulation for estimating power for the OLS-based naive, PPI, or PPI++ estimators. This function repeatedly calls ppi_ols_rep_one() and aggregates:

    1. Empirical rejection rate (empirical power),

    2. Monte Carlo SE,

    3. Estimated quadratic forms \(A = a^\top H^{-1}\Sigma_{YY}H^{-1}a\), \(B = a^\top H^{-1}\Sigma_{ff}H^{-1}a\), \(C = a^\top H^{-1}\Sigma_{Yf}H^{-1}a\),

    4. Closed-form variance and Wald power,

    5. Diagnostic summary table.

    ppi_ols_empirical_power(
  R,
  n,
  N,
  X_sampler_L,
  f_generator,
  model_type,
  a,
  delta,
  theta0,
  ppi_type = c("PPI", "PPI++"),
  lambda_mode = c("plugin", "oracle"),
  lambda_external = FALSE,
  n_external = ceiling(n/2),
  PPIpp_crossfit = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = 1,
  keep_reps = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    R

    Number of Monte Carlo repetitions.

    n

    Number of labeled observations.

    N

    Number of unlabeled observations.

    X_sampler_L

    Covariate generator.

    f_generator

    Signal generator.

    model_type

    Predictive model class for \(\hat f\).

    a

    Contrast vector of length \(p\).

    delta

    Effect size.

    theta0

    True theta.

    ppi_type

    "PPI" or "PPI++".

    lambda_mode

    "plugin" or "oracle".

    lambda_external

    Whether to estimate lambda from an external labeled dataset.

    n_external

    Size of external labeled dataset (if used).

    PPIpp_crossfit

    Whether to use cross-fitting in PPI++.

    alpha

    Wald test significance level.

    seed

    Optional seed.

    keep_reps

    Logical; whether or not output intermediate statistics. Default FALSE.

    Value

    A list with:

    empirical_power

    Empirical rejection rate over R reps.

    mc_se

    Monte Carlo SE of power.

    avg_theta_hat

    mean(\(\hat\theta\)).

    avg_se_hat

    mean estimated SE.

    avg_lambda_hat

    mean(\(\hat\lambda\)).

    A_hat, B_hat, C_hat

    Monte Carlo means of quadratic forms.

    lambda_star_hat

    Closed-form minimizing λ.

    se_theory

    Closed-form SE.

    theoretical_power

    Closed-form Wald power.

    cov_var_table

    Tidy diagnostic table.

    reps

    (Optional) Raw replicate-level results, if keep_reps = TRUE.
